description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity levy and surcharge on Imported goods (petrol, gas oil/diesel) with effect from 24th June 2020, for a period of two months
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance, specifically an order under Section 10A that levies a surcharge on imported goods. It involves regulatory action (imposing new surcharges) under existing legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, and the primary purpose is regulatory/legal rather than about government personnel or structure.
